title: QDW's current Forge integration test uses a local simulator, not qdw-forge
evidence: tests/integration/test_estate_forge_integration.py imports qdw.federation.forge_client.ForgeClient; that class says it simulates Forge execution and writes Forge state into QDW DB.
fix: Delete production fake; move any fake under tests only. All federation integration tests must use qdw-forge ASGI/HTTP process.

title: FederationService is constructed without GitGoblin, Dell or Forge clients/adapters
evidence: QDWSystem creates FederationService(system=self, store=...) only.
fix: Add typed federation settings/composition and fail explicitly when configured endpoints are unavailable.

title: Live protocol mismatch: QDW calls /v1/export/qdw but GitGoblin exposes only /v1/export/cuntgoblin
evidence: Current GitGoblin API has legacy exporter; integrations/qdw.py is absent at current HEAD.
fix: Implement versioned QDW export endpoint in GitGoblin and contract-test it over HTTP.

title: QDW migration duplicates Forge-owned lease/certificate state and stores plaintext lease token
evidence: 0010_federation.sql creates forge_leases(token TEXT) and forge_invocation_certs in QDW.
fix: Deprecate those tables, purge token material, retain only external refs/digests/observed status in QDW.

title: Forge verification trusts caller-authored passed boolean
evidence: VerifyBody has certificate_id + passed; InvocationService.bind_verification uses passed directly.
fix: Use CertificateReference resolved/validated against an allowlisted issuer and exact invocation/output digest.

title: Forge idempotency lookup occurs before lease authorization
evidence: InvocationService returns existing client_request_id row before leases.verify().
fix: Verify lease/token first; scope idempotency to authorized lease/client_request_id and validate request digest.

title: Forge allowed_operations is not enforced by invocation
evidence: Lease contains allowed_operations; invocation path does not require invoke permission.
fix: Lease verification must assert requested operation is allowed.

title: Forge lease spend is charged using advertised estimate but actual dispatcher cost is not reconciled
evidence: leases.consume(est_cost) occurs before dispatch; DB later records returned actual cost.
fix: Reserve estimated maximum then atomically settle actual cost/refund delta; failure cost policy explicit.

title: Forge activation mutates the manifest/hash of an immutable asset_id@version
evidence: activate() changes status/certificate_id, recomputes manifest_hash and overwrites same version.
fix: Separate immutable manifest from mutable activation state/certificate binding.

title: Forge profile learning can double-count the same certificate
evidence: record_verified increments posterior whenever given a non-empty certificate_id; no unique applied-verification record.
fix: Persist unique verification application keyed by certificate/subject and make replay idempotent.

title: fixed_request_cost_usd does not survive QDW Route persistence/restart
evidence: Route contains fixed_request_cost_usd; PersistentBanditStore save/load omits it and schema migrations do not add the column.
fix: New immutable migration adds column; save/load roundtrip mandatory.

title: No canonical federation execution transaction/state machine exists
evidence: sync, candidate conversion, route bindings and Forge adapter exist separately; no live path performs route→invoke→verify→cost→learn.
fix: Add FederationRuntime owned by QDW with durable attempt state and recovery.

title: Current federation tests are mostly direct dict/unit integration rather than sibling-service contracts
evidence: GitGoblin and Dell tests feed hand-built dicts; Forge test uses local simulator.
fix: Independent black-box test lab starts real ASGI apps/processes and only uses public protocols.

title: tests/e2e is empty despite V10/V11 claims elsewhere
evidence: Current tests/e2e tree contains only __init__.py.
fix: Put the real federation V10/V11 tests in tests/e2e and make them mandatory in CI.

title: Current Dell integration test documents a known recommended-cost loss and still passes
evidence: test_dell_integration.py comments that recommended route cost is lost.
fix: Turn into a failing regression; federation response exposes complete candidate facts.

title: Dell still coerces unknown output price to zero for nonzero output workloads
evidence: calculate_workload_cost says unknown must not become zero, then sets missing output_per_m to 0.
fix: If output_tokens_per_request > 0 and output price is unknown, return None.

title: GitGoblin opportunity proposals are returned by sync but not integrated into QDW evidence/scoring lifecycle
evidence: FederationService returns raw opportunity_proposals and leaves importer for later.
fix: Persist proposal snapshot/reference and synthesize QDW Opportunity only through QDW policy/evidence gates.

title: No proven GitGoblin→QDW→Forgejo→Forge→QDW certificate flow
evidence: Current tests never span the actual services.
fix: Finish-line V11 test in this pack defines the exact cross-service flow.

title: Forgejo sync is unpinned, unpaginated and weakly auditable
evidence: list_org_repos uses limit=50 only; qdw.yaml read at default branch; broad errors collapse to a count.
fix: Paginate, resolve immutable commit SHA first, record source repo/ref/file digest and typed errors.

title: Repo2Bench task identity embeds local filesystem repository path
evidence: task repository=str(repo) and task ID hashes str(repo)+sha.
fix: Use canonical repository URI + source commit; local checkout path is execution metadata only.

title: Forge schema is a mutable bootstrap string, not strict numbered migrations
evidence: Database.migrate executes SCHEMA via executescript.
fix: Introduce numbered immutable schema migrations before production federation data accumulates.

title: Two different production modules export a class named ForgeClient
evidence: clients.py has HTTP ForgeClient; forge_client.py has local simulated ForgeClient.
fix: One production client: ForgeHTTPClient. Test doubles stay under tests/lab.

title: External clients use module-level httpx.request instead of injected clients
evidence: BaseClient._request calls httpx.request directly.
fix: Inject httpx.Client/AsyncClient for connection reuse, tracing and deterministic transport tests.

title: Default branches are currently unprotected
evidence: branch API reports protected=false.
fix: Require federation CI status + review before pin/release promotion.

title: Latest QDW green count followed deletion of multiple superseded adversarial tests
evidence: HEAD commit removed nine old tests.
fix: Require replacement behavior/mutation coverage for each removed invariant, especially migration/trust/concurrency.
